subject: public-health

source.board: Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH)
source.qualification: Accreditation Criteria — Schools of Public Health & Public Health Programs
source.document: Criteria amended March 2024 — foundational public health knowledge (D1), MPH foundational competencies (D2), applied practice and integrative learning (D5, D7), bachelor's foundational domains (D9)
source.track: Accreditation standard · undergraduate majors and MPH programmes · the curriculum domains every accredited public health programme must teach

note: Units follow the criteria's curriculum structure in teaching order: the foundational public health knowledge areas (D1), then the MPH competency domains (D2) from evidence-based approaches through policy, leadership and communication, closing with the applied practice experience and integrative learning experience. The profession's history and determinants map to the foundational lessons; methods, systems and planning feed the intermediate lessons; policy, leadership and the capstone practice units carry the advanced and expert lessons.
